thread:
emily: Heads up — telemetry flagged a possible service account key leak in a partner archive (s3). Link: https://s3.partner-company/archives/abc123 (redacted). Need quick remediation + audit logging. Anyone available to triage & rotate? @raj @sarah :alert:
raj: On it. Can you paste the SA email and example key snippet? I'll start scoped rotation.
emily: sa: dataflow-ingest@redwood-prod. Found one key string in the archive around 2026-03-20. Assume compromised until proven otherwise.
sarah: I can handle Vault and KMS reissue. Raj — can you disable the old GCP key and create a new one? I'll update vault secrets and trigger infra rollout.
raj: Plan: 1) disable current key: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=dataflow-ingest@redwood-prod` 2) create new key: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create newkey.json --iam-account=...` 3) upload to vault: `vault kv put secret/data/dataflow key=@newkey.json` 4) trigger infra pipeline. Also checking RBAC so only deploy-bot can read that path.
sec-bot: Audit: created alert "sa-key-exposure-1807778888" and enabled sink `projects/redwood-prod/sinks/sa-leak-archive` for 90d retention. Created by @sec-bot.
kevin: I'll run the vault put + bump secret version and add a quick smoke test hook. Tagging ops: @oncall to watch config rollout.
oncall: watching. If rollout fails, revert with `INFRA_SKIP_SECRETS=true` in the pipeline.
emily: We also need to scan for other occurrences. @sarah can you grep partner artifacts and our S3 for other drops? Example scan: `aws s3 cp s3://partner-archive/abc123 - | grep -E 'AIza|-----BEGIN PRIVATE|-----BEGIN RSA'`
sarah: Starting scan now. Found 2 additional hits in backup file `backup-20260318.gz`. Will compile list and ask partner to scrub.
raj: RBAC note: after immediate rotation, we should migrate to Workload Identity (no long-lived SA keys). POC: https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/workload-identity-federation. For now, rotate both prod + staging keys.
emily: Agreed — immediate full rotation first, then WIF migration.
kevin: I'll update runbook entry `secrets/sa-key-leak` with commands and a post-incident checklist.
sec-bot: Reminder: create a KMS rewrap key and restrict policy to `service:secrets-service`. Example: `gcloud kms keys create rewrap-key --location=global --keyring=prod-keyring --purpose=encryption` and apply IAM binding to `serviceAccount:secrets-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` only.
sarah: Vault steps I'm running: 1) `vault kv put secret/data/dataflow key=@newkey.json` 2) set lease/ttl on bootstrap token to 7d 3) enable file audit: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log`
raj: After rotation, we should scan terraform + infra for plaintext references to the old key. Quick search: `grep -R "dataflow-ingest@redwood-prod" infra/ | xargs -r sed -n '1,120p'` — remove any hardcoded creds.
emily: Target timeline: complete rotation + deploy by EOD PST. Update this thread with progress.
sarah: Scan complete: 2 extra artifacts found and partner has scrubbed the public copies. I archived copies to our secure bucket `s3://redwood-secure/forensics/1807778888` and will share access list.
raj: Disabled old key `KEY_ID: 4a1b2c3d`. Created new key and uploaded to vault at `secret/data/dataflow`.
kevin: Secrets updated, infra pipeline triggered. Will monitor config-service for auth 403s and roll back if needed.
oncall: Saw a few 500s during config rollout, rolled back one pod and restarted. No auth failures observed from apps.
emily: Rotation complete. Creating postmortem ticket ENGSEC-2026 and collecting timeline/logs. @sarah can you draft the postmortem?
sarah: Drafted and attached timeline, artifact list, commands, and suggested mitigations (WIF migration + short TTLs). Will open ENGSEC-2026 and link here.
sec-bot: Post-rotation summary: old key disabled, 3 artifacts removed (partner-archive + 2 backups), audit sink enabled, rotation ticket ENGSEC-2026 created. Evidence archived at `s3://redwood-secure/forensics/1807778888`.
emily: Thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) migrate SA to Workload Identity by EOW Q2 2) add enforcement to CI to block commits with `private_key` strings 3) schedule RBAC review for vault paths referencing SA keys. I'll add to roadmap and assign owners.
kevin: I'll add the CI grep check to the pre-commit hook and pipeline scanner.
raj: Also propose short-lived keys via KMS-wrapped tokens as an interim step.
emily: Good. Closing active remediation. Please move further discussion to ENGSEC-2026 for postmortem/retrospective. :white_check_mark:
